questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Past Simple — Regular Verbs: Regular past: add -ed (work → worked, play → played). Pronunciation: /t/, /d/, /ɪd/.

questions.question: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: ___ saw Maria at the party.
questions.explanation: High-frequency irregulars: go→went, see→saw, have→had, do→did, make→made, come→came, get→got, take→took.

questions.question: Complete: ___ started gym last month.
questions.explanation: Last + period: last month, last year | … ago: three years ago | In + past year: in 2019 | On + past day: on Monday (finished)
